evidence.quote: We performed 16S rRNA sequencing and untargeted metabolomics on follicular fluid samples from 26 women with POR and 25 normoresponsive controls
The V4 region of the 16S rRNA gene was amplified with primers 515F/806R

controls.types: DNA extraction negative controls; PCR negative controls

evidence.quote: DNA extraction negative controls (D1-D5) and PCR negative controls (P1-P5) were processed together with study samples
Taxa identified as experimental contaminants from negative controls were flagged and removed from downstream analyses

notes: Acinetobacter and Pseudomonas are on the authors' contaminant list (E0012) yet A. johnsonii and P. mendocina are reported in cross-omics results (E0042); flagged true. Ralstonia/Burkholderia/Methylobacterium/Sphingomonas only named as removed contaminants. Lactobacillus dominant. Microbial findings described as exploratory; conclusion read as weakly claimed. Controls' sequencing implied by contaminant identification from them.
